data.long_meaning: Derived from Ghaza, meaning 'battleground'. A name for a girl who is victorious in her spiritual journey and overcomes challenges with courage and determination. The name Ghazulah carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghazulah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
